Wedgewood Partners Has Lifted Celgene (CELG) Stake by $29.70 Million; As Facebook (FB) Stock Declined, Shareholder Steadfast Capital Management LP Has Trimmed Its Stake
May 26, 2018 - By Vivian Park
Robert Pitts decreased its stake in Facebook Inc (FB) by 8.78% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Steadfast Capital Management Lp sold 53,269 shares as the company’s stock declined 14.10% with the market. The hedge fund run by Robert Pitts held 553,535 shares of the technology company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $97.68 million, down from 606,804 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Steadfast Capital Management Lp who had been investing in Facebook Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $535.28 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 0.54% or $1.01 during the last trading session, reaching $184.92. About 9.79M shares traded. Facebook, Inc. (NASDAQ:FB) has risen 8.48% since May 26, 2017 and is uptrending. It has underperformed by 3.07% the S&P500.
Wedgewood Partners Inc increased its stake in Celgene Corp (CELG) by 42.19% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Wedgewood Partners Inc bought 285,542 shares as the company’s stock declined 19.30% with the market. The institutional investor held 962,318 shares of the major pharmaceuticals company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $100.43 million, up from 676,776 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Wedgewood Partners Inc who had been investing in Celgene Corp for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $57.11B market cap company. The stock decreased 1.14% or $0.91 during the last trading session, reaching $78.63. About 4.78M shares traded. Celgene Corporation (NASDAQ:CELG) has declined 31.28% since May 26, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 42.83% the S&P500.
